clips.title: The story
paras: At the Sepulcher, Dalar Dawnweaver turns his arcane learning toward the Forsaken’s enemies. Once an archmage of Dalaran, he died when the Scourge destroyed the city and later broke free of the Lich King’s control. Now he studies Dalaran’s lingering presence and seeks to end the madness of Archmage Arugal.

Dalar Dawnweaver once held high rank among the Kirin Tor, walking the Violet Citadel’s halls when Dalaran stood at the height of arcane mastery. His mortal life ended when the Scourge sacked the city to prepare for Archimonde’s summoning. Raised as a mindless thrall of the Lich King, Dalar broke free alongside Lady Sylvanas Windrunner when the Scourge’s grip faltered. Now at the Sepulcher, he keeps an archmage’s keen intellect and devotes it to protecting the Forsaken realm.

Silverpine Forest faces many dangers, and Dalar directs the Sepulcher’s arcane strategy. To the south, Dalaran wizards occupy Ambermill, where they pursue matters he aims to uncover and disrupt. Shadowfang Keep lies closer, its feral worgen prowling the woods. Dalar knows his former colleague, Archmage Arugal, well. He carefully directs efforts to stop Arugal’s beastly creations before they overrun the region.
